skill.summary: Turns your protocol and analysis workflow into publication-ready Methods text. Use when writing or revising the Methods section of a biomedical manuscript, ensuring it complies with reporting guidelines (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, TRIPOD), matches what is in the Results section, and satisfies journal-specific word limits and declarations. Also triggers on "write my methods", "revise my methods section", "how to report my statistics", "what do I need to include in methods for [study type]", or "make my methods CONSORT-compliant".

review.exception_reason: Maintainer explicitly authorizes publication with Unknown on 2026-09-14 while provenance, license coverage or bundled-material redistribution evidence remains unresolved. Unresolved scope: Bundled reporting_guidelines.md includes multiple third-party reporting checklists; attribution and redistribution evidence need review. Original declarations, attributions, source commit/path and all payload bytes are preserved. Unknown is an uncertainty label, not a permission grant or independent safety/accuracy endorsement.
